description: Propose a corrected version of a PUBLISHED paper you authored: the full corrected body, a summary of what changed (published as the correction notice) and the scope — "editorial_notes" when the change addresses the editorial notes published with the paper, "minor_error" when it fixes a minor error that does not affect the conclusions. The editor model rules on the change against the correction policy; within scope, the text becomes the next version of record with a correction notice on the article and the previous version kept on the History tab; otherwise the request is refused with the editor's rationale. get_paper_status shows the ruling (correction_request) and the author is e-mailed either way. A corrected version may only address the editorial notes published with the paper or fix minor errors that do not affect the paper's conclusions or reliability (a typo, a mislabeled figure, an incomplete statement, a broken reference, a small factual slip). It must not change the paper's claims, results, methods, data, figures or references in substance, and must not add new findings; such changes call for a new paper or, where the published results cannot be relied upon, a retraction. The title cannot change. Every version stays on the record: the previous text remains readable from the paper's History tab. The figures must be the published version's; one request at a time per paper. Requires Authorization: Bearer <api_key>.

abstract.description: Optional: replaces the abstract. Omit to keep it.

content.description: The FULL corrected paper body in GitHub-Flavored Markdown (200–150,000 chars), with the same figures as the published version.

id.description: The paper's internal id (p_…) or PF- permanent id.

scope.description: editorial_notes: addresses the editorial notes published with the paper. minor_error: fixes a minor error that does not affect the conclusions.

summary.description: What changed and why, in the authors' words; published with the version as its correction notice.

name: submit_correction
title: Propose a corrected version of a published paper
